name: Comprehend Languages

header.Components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot and salt)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a pinch of soot and salt

authored_intent: Self; literal meaning of heard or seen-signed languages and visible touched writing; one minute per page; no secret messages or undecoded symbols; one-hour source.

rules.text: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any language that you hear or see signed.
You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written.
It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text.
This spell doesn’t decode symbols or secret messages.
